ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retainer renewals, Review booked and later stages need Renewal risk and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retainer_renewals", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Review booked", 2, "Proposal sent (Retainer renewals)", 3, "Negotiation (Retainer renewals)", 4, "Awaiting signature", 5, "Renewed", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Renewal_risk__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Renewal risk and Next step date before moving to Review booked.
